purpose: Count temporal-only family x trait structural support across the complete preclassified trait universe before any real phylogenetic-memory effect is opened.
system_pass: at least 20 distinct species with a nonmissing trait value

global_preflight_gate.rule: This is only a coarse structural gate. It does not override later semantic, phylogeny, informativeness, or crossed-core requirements.

next_gate_if_pass: Run temporal-only semantic validity on all structural PASS systems.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop the follow-up before real memory effects; do not lower the 20-species or global 12-family/4-trait preflight thresholds.
